# GreenBean Coffee — Your Daily Coffee Ritual

## Overview

Build a 5-page corporate website for GreenBean Coffee, a premium coffeehouse chain. The site should feel like walking into a warm, well-designed coffee shop — inviting, modern, and just a touch playful. The audience spans everyday coffee lovers, loyalty members, gift card shoppers, and casual browsers. The primary goals are driving online ordering, showcasing seasonal drinks, growing the rewards program, and making gift card purchases effortless.

## Visual Direction

Think earthy greens, warm creams, and rich coffee browns. Use a clean sans-serif typeface (like Inter or DM Sans) for body text, paired with a slightly more expressive heading font. Generous whitespace, rounded corners, and soft shadows should give the site a friendly, approachable feel. Photography placeholders should suggest lifestyle coffee imagery — hands wrapped around mugs, latte art, cozy café interiors. Keep the layout modern and airy, never cluttered.

## Key Priorities

- **Home page impact**: The hero and seasonal drink highlights are the first impression — they should feel vibrant and immediately actionable with clear ordering CTAs.
- **Rewards redemption tabs**: The tabbed star-level redemption display (25 through 400 Stars) is a core interactive element. Make the tab switching feel smooth and the content instantly clear — this is what convinces people to join.
- **Gift card carousels**: Both the featured and category-specific carousels need polished next/previous navigation. Six occasion categories should be easy to browse without overwhelming the page.
- **Store locator interactivity**: The search, filter toggle, and pickup/delivery switching should all feel responsive and functional, even with placeholder data.
- **Menu organization**: The sidebar + category layout must be intuitive. Users should quickly scan across drinks, food, and at-home coffee sections.
- **Responsive design** is required across all pages — pay special attention to the footer accordion behavior on mobile.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

3	## Brand
4	GreenBean Coffee is a premium coffeehouse chain offering handcrafted beverages, a loyalty rewards program, gift cards, and a convenient store locator. Our tone is warm, modern, and playful — inviting coffee lovers to make GreenBean part of their daily ritual.
5	
6	Brand colors: #00824A (primary green), #32462F (dark forest), #F3CEA1 (warm cream)
7	
8	## Hero Content
9	Title: It's a great day for coffee
10	CTA: "Start an order"
11	
12	## Featured Product
13	Title: New Citrus Energy Refreshers just dropped
14	Body: Introducing a new kind of energy. Now you can enjoy the Refreshers you love with extra caffeine from nature and a B-vitamin boost.
15	CTA: "Give them a try"
16	
17	## Afternoon Promo
18	Title: Your afternoon reset
19	Body: When 2 p.m. hits and you need a little boost, we've got you covered — with tasty drinks, snacks and sweet treats to keep the good vibes going.
20	CTA: "Explore our afternoon menu"
21	
22	## AI Recommendation
23	Title: Inspire your next order with ChatGPT
24	Body: Discover drinks that fit your mood, goals and preferences in just a few conversational prompts.
25	CTA: "Learn more"
26	
27	## Seasonal Highlight — Fruity
28	Title: A new fruity twist is here
29	Body: Introducing vibrant Iced Mango Cream Matcha and rich Iced Mango Cream Chai. Topped with velvety mango cream cold foam for a delicious pop of sweetness, sip after sip.
30	CTA: "Order now"
31	
32	## Seasonal Highlight — Spring
33	Title: Spring starts now
34	Body: Iced Lavender Cream Matcha and Iced Lavender Cream Chai are back in bloom, joined by the new Iced Ube Coconut Macchiato, Toasted Coconut Cream Cold Brew and so much more.
35	CTA: "See the spring menu"
36	
37	## Nondairy Promo
38	Title: Nondairy, No extra
39	Body: Enjoy your beverage with your choice of nondairy milk — like oat, almond, coconut or soy — for no additional charge.
40	CTA: "Start an order"
41	
42	## Menu Categories
43	Sidebar navigation listing all menu categories:
44	
45	**The Latest:** Trending · Citrus Energy Refreshers
46	
47	**Drinks:** Protein Beverages · Hot Coffee · Cold Coffee · Matcha · Hot Tea · Cold Tea · Refreshers · Frappuccino® Blended Beverage · Hot Chocolate, Lemonade & More · Bottled Beverages
48	
49	**Food:** Breakfast · Bakery · Treats · Lunch · Lite Bites
50	
51	**At Home Coffee:** Whole Bean · GreenBean VIA® Instant · Shopping Bag
52	
53	## Rewards Tiers
54	
55	| Tier | Star Threshold | Key Benefits |
56	|------|---------------|--------------|
57	| Green | Less than 500 ★ per year | Free birthday treat · Earn 1 ★ per $1 · Free Mod Mondays · Double Stars with personal cup |
58	| Gold | 500+ ★ per year | 7-day birthday window · Earn 1.2 ★ per $1 · Stars won't expire · 4 extra Double Star Days |
59	| Reserve | 2,500+ ★ per year | 30-day birthday window · Earn 1.7 ★ per $1 · Exclusive global coffee experiences · Free personalized Reserve Card · 6 extra Double Star Days |
60	
61	## Rewards Redemption Levels
62	
63	| Stars | Reward | Value |
64	|-------|--------|-------|
65	| 25 ★ | $1 off a drink customization (espresso shot, syrup, or cold foam) | Up to $1 |
66	| 60 ★ | Up to $2 off your order | Up to $2 |
67	| 100 ★ | Brewed coffee or tea, bakery item, packaged snacks and more | Up to $6 |
68	| 200 ★ | Handcrafted drink or hot breakfast | Up to $10 |
69	| 300 ★ | Sandwich, protein box or packaged coffee | Up to $16 |
70	| 400 ★ | Select GreenBean merchandise | Up to $20 |
71	
72	## Rewards How It Works
73	1. **Collect Stars** — Earn Stars by making eligible purchases and participating in challenges, offers and games.
74	2. **Enjoy free treats** — Redeem your Stars for free food, drinks and more. Look forward to a birthday treat on us every year.
75	3. **Unlock benefits** — Keep earning Stars to increase your status and help you get to free faster. Discover more benefits at every level.
76	
77	## Rewards Partnerships
78	- Link your Delta account to earn miles, Bonus Stars and access exclusive offers.
79	- Link your Marriott Bonvoy account to earn points, Bonus Stars and access exciting member experiences.
80	
81	## Gift Card Categories
82	Gift card designs organized by occasion with carousel browsing:
83	
84	- **Featured** — Spring GreenBean · A Little Perk · Friends Buy Friends Coffee · Thank You · You're A Star · Great Work Deserves Coffee · Happy Birthday
85	- **Birthday** — Happy Birthday · Let's Celebrate You · Happy Birthday
86	- **Thank You** — Thank You · It's My Treat · Big Thank You
87	- **Celebration** — Yay · Celebration · Cheers · Celebrate With Coffee
88	- **Appreciation** — You're A Star · Cheers To You · Friends Buy Friends Coffee
89	- **Encouragement** — Great Day For Coffee · You Got This · A Little Perk
90	- **Workplace** — Above & Beyond · Great Work Deserves Coffee
91	- **Anytime** — GreenBean · Café · Heritage Sirens
92	
93	## Business Gifting
94	Title: Business gifting — simplified
95	Body: Bulk send physical or digital GreenBean Cards to gift, reward, incentivize, or show appreciation towards your customers, clients and team members. Minimum 15 cards per order.
96	CTA: "Shop now"
97	
98	## eGift Info
99	A GreenBean eGift card is a GreenBean Gift Card that is purchased and sent digitally. Send up to 10 eGifts per purchase. Select a design to start! Received a gift card? Add or reload, check balance, or view Card Terms & Conditions.
100	
101	Register Gift Cards and eGifts to a GreenBean® Rewards account and members earn Stars on qualifying purchases when you pay with that card.
102

104	- **Order type toggle:** Pickup / Delivery
105	- **Search input:** Type a city, zip code, or address — suggestions appear as you type
106	- **Filter button:** Opens filter panel to refine results (drive-thru, mobile ordering, etc.)
107	- **Map view:** Interactive map powered by Google Maps with store pins
108	- **Results list:** Nearby stores with address, hours, and available features

112	**About Us:** Our Company · Our Coffee · About GreenBean · GreenBean Archive · Investor Relations · Customer Service · Contact Us

2. **Hero** - Dark forest green gradient background (#32462F to #1a2e18), title "It's a great day for coffee", CTA button "Start an order" (white btn), secondary CTA (outline-white). Include a decorative SVG placeholder on the right.
3. **Featured Product** - Full-width promo card with green-light background. Title: "New Citrus Energy Refreshers just dropped", Body: "Introducing a new kind of energy. Now you can enjoy the Refreshers you love with extra caffeine from nature and a B-vitamin boost.", CTA: "Give them a try" (btn-primary)
4. **Promo Grid (2 columns)** - Two cards side by side:
   - Left (cream-bg): "Your afternoon reset" / "When 2 p.m. hits and you need a little boost, we've got you covered — with tasty drinks, snacks and sweet treats to keep the good vibes going." / CTA "Explore our afternoon menu"
   - Right (white-bg with border): "Inspire your next order with ChatGPT" / "Discover drinks that fit your mood, goals and preferences in just a few conversational prompts." / CTA "Learn more"
5. **Seasonal Grid (2 columns)** - Two seasonal highlight cards with gradient backgrounds and overlay text:
   - Left (orange/red gradient): "A new fruity twist is here" / body text about Iced Mango Cream Matcha etc. / "Order now"
   - Right (purple gradient): "Spring starts now" / body text about Iced Lavender Cream Matcha etc. / "See the spring menu"
6. **Nondairy Banner** - Cream background card: "Nondairy, No extra" / body about nondairy milk options / "Start an order"
7. **Cookie Banner** - Fixed bottom bar: "This site uses cookies, but not the kind you eat" / body text / "Change cookie settings" (outline) + "Agree" (primary) buttons. Has id="cookie-banner" with data-cookie-agree and data-cookie-settings attributes on buttons.
8. **Footer** - Dark forest green background. 5-column grid with these sections:
   - About Us: Our Company, Our Coffee, About GreenBean, GreenBean Archive, Investor Relations, Customer Service, Contact Us
   - Careers: Culture and Values, Belonging at GreenBean, College Achievement Plan, Alumni Community, U.S. Careers, International Careers
   - Social Impact: Communities, GreenBean Foundation, Sustainability, Environmental and Social Impact Reporting
   - For Business Partners: Landlord Support Center, Suppliers, Corporate Gift Card Sales, Office and Foodservice Coffee
   - Order and Pick Up: Order on the App, Order on the Web, Delivery, Order and Pick Up Options, Explore and Find Coffee for Home
   Footer bottom: social icons (placeholder SVG circles), legal links, copyright "© 2026 GreenBean Coffee. All rights reserved."
   Each footer column should have class "footer-col" with h3 heading, and links wrapped in div.footer-links for accordion behavior on mobile.

Also include:
- Mobile nav (div.mobile-nav) with same links as desktop nav
- Mobile menu button (button.mobile-menu-btn with 3 span elements)
- All image placeholders should be styled div elements with appropriate background colors and text

Brand colors: --green: #00824A, --forest: #32462F, --cream: #F3CEA1
Use CSS classes from styles.css (container, btn, btn-primary, btn-outline, btn-outline-white, btn-white, hero, promo-card, seasonal-card, nondairy-banner, cookie-banner, site-footer, etc.)

The logo SVG should be a simple coffee bean shape. Use inline SVG.

Make sure all inter-page navigation uses relative paths (e.g., href="menu.html").

steps.message:
The GreenBean Coffee website is complete. Here's what was built in `/app/output/`:

**9 files total:**
- `index.html` — Home page with hero, featured product, promo grid, seasonal highlights, nondairy banner, cookie banner
- `menu.html` — Full menu with sidebar navigation and 7 category sections (28 item cards)
- `rewards.html` — Rewards program with how-it-works steps, 3 status tiers, 6-tab redemption display, partnerships, app download
- `gift.html` — Gift cards with featured carousel, 7 category carousels, business gifting, eGift info, FAQ accordion
- `store-locator.html` — Two-column layout with search/filter sidebar, 5 store cards, and map placeholder
- `styles.css` — Complete design system (earthy greens, warm creams, DM Sans + Inter fonts, responsive breakpoints)
- `scripts.js` — All interactions: cookie banner dismiss, mobile menu toggle, footer accordion, redemption tabs, carousel navigation, FAQ expand/collapse, store locator search/filter/order-type toggle
- `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` — SEO assets

**SEO:** JSON-LD CafeOrCoffeeShop schema, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, geo tags, canonical URLs. All pages have consistent footer links matching the source brief, and all navigation uses relative paths for direct browser opening.
